title: CryptGate
tagline: CryptGate: Crypto Payment Gateway for web2/web3 applications with account abstraction and zk-based identities
description:
Features:
1. User onboarding through account abstraction (No need to manage Seed Phrase, Mnemonics, Private key)
2. Pay transaction fees through Credit Cards (Top up FIAT wallet and pay in Crypto through our SDK)
3. Scan and Pay for Crypto transactions (Scan and pay for COFFEE/FOOD/GOODS in Crypto through our app)
4. SDK for Crypto Payment Gateway (Pay with Crypto on any web2/web3 platform)
how_its_made:
Problem being solved
1. User onboading in single click where users don't need to worrry about remembering seed phrase, mnenomics, private key, etc
2. Providing a way to integrate an SDK to any web2/web3 apps and making crypto payments possible through only our Crypto Payment Gateway SDK.
3. Pay transaction fees through Credit Cards: Users need to top up their FIAT wallet and they can pay in Crypto through our SDK which removes the hassle of onboarding "X" number of tokens on different chain. We are using ERC-4337 paymaster concept.
4. Scan and Pay for Crypto transactions: Scan and pay for COFFEE/FOOD/GOODS in Crypto through our app

We are using account abstraction for smart contract wallets and zk-based identities. We are providing a crypto payment gateway SDK which can be used to purchases, entertainment, bills, etc

Future Plans:
1. We'll launch our both web and mobile apps for end users
2. We'll launch our SDK for web2/web3 application owners to integrate our Crypto payment Gateway SDK
3. We'll make transactions private using zk-SNARK and zk-STARK.
4. We'll implement FACEID/Biometric based zk ID so that no personal information is shared by users
